title: Japanese Lentil Pilaf
description: A simple Japanese-inspired dish made with lentils and pilaf. This recipe is a great option for vegetarians and vegans.

ingredients.name: lovely vegetable broth
ingredients.notes: you can also use store-bought vegetable broth

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the green onion and cook for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add the lentils and cook for 1-2 minutes until lightly browned.
Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the vegetable broth and soy sauce. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the toasted sesame seeds.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
